rule: Time: "Selama 7 hari" (duration). Place: "mengelilingi kota itu" is the literal path of movement around the city (PR4), not an affected object (PR3). Both describe the circling event; neither restricts the other (1.3 step 2).

Place: "di dalam kapal" locates the death and "kembali ke Silla" is a goal (PR4). Time: "abad ke-13" dates the chronicle inside the NP; "di dalam perjalanan" is an event with no temporal word (PR5). The time phrase identifies the source (R2) and does not restrict the place of death, so PAR.

Time: "Antara 1947 - 1948". Place: "di Universitas Johns Hopkins" says where he held the post (institution note: where something is). Copular state with the place inside the predicate value; the time span narrows when it holds ("at JHU, given 1947-48"; the reverse does not fit) (1.3 step 3).
